final_message:
Configured the requested host names and MX records, with all 20 PCs using the recursive resolver at `10.14.5.13`. Existing connections, addresses, and routes were preserved.

The assumed DNS roles are: root on pc1; `.com` on pc2; `.net` on pc3; `example.com` on pc10; `service.com` on pc14; `lab.net` on pc15; `tools.net` on pc16; resolver on pc17. Those eight devices now use `kathara/bind`.

Updated [lab.conf](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-ahddjd2k/lab/lab.conf), the PC startup files, and created BIND configuration and zone files. Shell syntax checks passed. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and runtime DNS queries remain to be checked externally.
